title: One subsequence along which all test-function integrals converge
statement: Let X be a locally compact Hausdorff, second countable topological space (universe u). Let (μ_k)_{k∈ℕ} be Radon outer measures on X (Simon Def. 4.6) with sup_k μ_k(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ X, and write μ̄_k := caratheodoryMeasure μ_k. Then there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ such that for every f ∈ C_c(X, ℝ) the real sequence (∫_X f dμ̄_{φ(k)})_{k∈ℕ} converges to some l ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] (μ : ℕ → OuterMeasure X), (∀ k, IsRadonOuterMeasure (μ k)) → (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ⨆ k, μ k K < ∞) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x ∂caratheodoryMeasure (μ (φ k))) atTop (𝓝 l)
